name: New Topic
about: Propose a new subject area (domain) for the book
title: "[Topic] "
labels: new-topic
assignees: ''
---

<!--
  A "topic" is a whole subject area that deserves its own domain, such as
  chemistry, silicon, ship or quantum. For a single procedure, use the
  "New Entry" template instead. See docs/TOPICS.md for the full criteria.
-->

## Subject
<!-- The area you want covered, in a few words. -->

## Why it belongs in the book
<!--
  What real need does this cover that the existing domains do not?
  Name the reader who would use it and what they would be able to do after.
-->

## Existing coverage
<!--
  Which of the current domains come closest? What is missing from them?
  Link to the entries you looked at.
-->

## Scope
<!--
  How many entries would this topic need to be useful? List the entries you
  would write first, with one line each.
-->

## Sources
<!--
  Which primary sources would back this topic, and what licences do they
  carry? Public domain, CC-BY, CC-BY-SA or your own original work.
-->

## Safety profile
<!--
  What is the highest risk a reader would face? Which entries would be
  yellow or red, and what training, equipment or authorisation would they
  need?
-->

## Acceptance criteria
<!--
  A topic is accepted when the need is real, the sources are open, the scope
  is writable and the safety profile can be stated. Tick the ones you believe
  are met.
-->

- [ ] The need is real and durable
- [ ] Primary sources are public domain or openly licensed
- [ ] A reader would act on the content
- [ ] The safety profile can be stated honestly
- [ ] The scope fits one or two contributors

## Anything else
